Various [[Pokémon merchandise]] has been released in connection with different series of [[Pokémon manga]]. Due to the comparatively higher popularity of the {{pkmn|games}}, {{pkmn|animation}}, and {{Trading Card Game}}, there is significantly less manga tie-in merchandise than there is compared to other Pokémon media. Regardless, several items have been released for retail sale and as promotional items.

==Magical Pokémon Journey==
A deck of playing cards featuring characters from [[Magical Pokémon Journey]] was released as a promotional item with [[Ciao]] magazine. Each suit in the set features a different character from the series - spades is {{MPJ|Pikachu}}, hearts is {{MPJ|Jigglypuff}}, clubs is {{MPJ|Squirtle}} and diamonds is {{MPJ|Clefairy}}. The majority of the artwork on the cards was created exclusively for this set. All of the Queens in the set feature [[Hazel]] alongside the suit's Pokémon, and all the Jacks likewise feature [[Almond]]. The Jokers in the set feature [[Grandpa]]. There is also a card included with the set which has no function in regular play but features all four Pokémon.

==Pokémon Adventures==
In commemoration of [[VIZ Media]]'s 25th anniversary, a swag bag was distributed at {{wp|San Diego Comic Con}} in 2011. The bag and its contents featured several of VIZ Media's licenses, including Pokémon. The bag itself featured an image of [[Pika]] from [[Pokémon Adventures]], and included was a [[Pokémon manga samplers|manga sampler]] featuring multiple story arcs from the Adventures series.

==Pokémon Pocket Monsters==
A paper fan featuring characters from the [[Pokémon Pocket Monsters]] manga was given away as a promotional item at the [[Shogakukan]] Comic Fair in 1997. The fan features {{PPM|Red}}, [[Red's Clefairy]], {{PPM|Red's Pikachu}} and several other Pokémon which debuted in [[Generation I]]. Artwork appears on one side of the fan in full colour and on the opposite side alternate artwork appears printed in red.

==Movie manga adaptations==
A promotional tote bag was released at San Diego Comic Con in 2008, commemorating five years since the first issue of VIZ Media's {{wp|Shonen Jump (magazine)|Shonen Jump magazine}}. It is yellow in colour and features artwork of characters from several of VIZ Media's licenses, including {{Ash}} and {{AP|Pikachu}} from the movie manga adaptation {{ma|The Rise of Darkrai}}.

==Multiple series==
===Manga boxed sets===
{{main|Manga boxed sets}}
[[VIZ Media]] has released several boxed sets of Pokémon manga, including [[Pokémon Adventures]] and [[Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure!]]. In addition to the collection of volumes in a specially made box, these sets typically include an incentive for purchasing the entire set, typically a small poster featuring artwork from the manga.

===Manga samplers===
{{main|Pokémon manga samplers}}
Several sampler versions of Pokémon manga series have been distributed by various means, including promotional events and as bonuses with home video releases of [[Pokémon animation]].
